claims.title: Arbitrary-multiplicity signed slack
claims.quantifier_scope: Every finite conjugation-invariant multiset and every integer matrix dimension q>=1.
assumptions: Simple real points are identified using original multiplicities; nonsimple real mass>=2 and pair total mass is even.
cannot_imply: Numerical rank determinations are not exact rank proofs.
No independent mathematical verification or authority promotion.

claims.title: Mixed selected-row estimate
claims.quantifier_scope: Every coordinate projection C and every signed operator in C01.
assumptions: U,E,F and R are the exact subspaces and residual in section 2.
cannot_imply: No flat-simple-diagonal replacement for arbitrary nonconstant vector profiles.
No independent mathematical verification or authority promotion.

claims.title: Cell-free mixed Toeplitz energy floor
claims.quantifier_scope: ceil(q/2)<=d<=q, alpha=d/q; arbitrary centers, depths and integer multiplicities.
assumptions: C01-C02; exponential sampling makes T Toeplitz and gives diag S=s.
cannot_imply: No direct assertion for noninteger alpha*q on an unchanged finite source matrix.
No independent mathematical verification or authority promotion.

claims.title: Direct sampled-to-continuous energy bound
claims.quantifier_scope: Every finite list with real diameter<=theta*q, 0<=theta<1 and alpha*q an integer.
assumptions: Conjugation invariance and complete multiplicity counting; classical csc-square partial fractions.
cannot_imply: No estimate with the real-diameter margin silently removed.
No independent mathematical verification or authority promotion.

claims.title: Fixed interior rectangular source moment
claims.quantifier_scope: First T->infinity for fixed b and smoothing width, then smoothing width->0.
assumptions: External PC from Lamzouri v1 Lemma 3.1; standard N(T)~T log(T)/(2pi).
cannot_imply: Not an independent audit of PC; not b=1 or b=b(T) uniformity.
No independent mathematical verification or authority promotion.

claims.title: Full-source direct sampling without deleting deep zeros
claims.statement: For q=4ceil(V_T/4), the sampling error at scale alpha is O_theta,alpha(T^(alpha theta-1)/log T).
assumptions: C04; source critical strip, reflection symmetry and N(T)~V_T; all original multiplicities retained.
cannot_imply: Does not prove a low-cost cell matching or bounded normalized depths.
No independent mathematical verification or authority promotion.

claims.title: Weaker source-conditional proportion consequence
claims.quantifier_scope: Asymptotic zero count, with height first and fixed theta then theta->1.
assumptions: C03,C05,C06 and the nonnegative signed slack.
cannot_imply: Weaker than the inspected 0.672500703679... benchmark; not a new best bound or an RH proof.
No independent mathematical verification or authority promotion.

claims.title: Resonant alias scope obstruction
claims.statement: For distinct simple real points 0,q, sampled and continuous moments differ by exactly 1.
assumptions: Finite constructed list of mass two, real diameter exactly q.
cannot_imply: Not a zeta-zero configuration or a counterexample to the correctly margin-restricted sampling lemma.
No independent mathematical verification or authority promotion.
